title: Lambda Durable Function — Flight Booking with Payment Callback & Saga Compensation (.NET)
description: A durable function that checks availability, suspends for external payment confirmation (callback), books a flight, and handles failures with saga compensation — demonstrating callbacks, durable timers, and compensation.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a Lambda durable function implementing a realistic flight booking workflow. It checks availability, creates a callback token for the payment gateway, and suspends execution at zero cost while waiting for confirmation.

Once the payment gateway confirms (via an API callback), the workflow resumes: authorizes payment, books the flight, waits for airline confirmation (durable timer), captures payment, and sends a confirmation email.

If the airline rejects the booking after payment authorization, the saga compensation pattern reverses the payment hold. The workflow spans minutes, making durable execution essential — a plain Lambda would time out.
